# Operator Health Check — 2026-03-12 02:51 UTC

## Summary
- PM2: 12 online, 1 stopped (`whisper`)
- Docker: multiple containers healthy/running, but issues detected in 4 containers
- Disk: `/` at 69% used (210G free)
- RAM: 11.3GB used / 27.5GB total, 0 swap configured
- GPU: RTX 4090 present, 20.5GB / 24.6GB VRAM in use by `VLLM::EngineCore`
- OpenClaw gateway: reachable on `127.0.0.1:18789`, but service status is inconsistent/out-of-date and `openclaw gateway status` reports `Runtime: stopped` while RPC probe is OK

## PM2
Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
Stopped: whisper

## Docker Issues
- `langfuse_langfuse-web_1` restarting
- `lidaros-frontend-1` unhealthy
- `omiximo-email-automation` unhealthy
- Several other containers are up and healthy/running

## Resource Notes
- No disk pressure threshold hit
- No RAM pressure threshold hit
- GPU memory usage is high but not saturated
- No immediate thermal or utilization spike detected

## OpenClaw Gateway Notes
- Probe target responded on loopback
- CLI reported systemd service disabled and out-of-date/non-standard service config
- Embedded service token warning present
- Group policy warnings exist for Telegram/WhatsApp allowlists with empty allowed senders

## Assessment
System is operational, but not clean. Main concerns are the stopped `whisper` PM2 process, unhealthy/restarting Docker services, and OpenClaw gateway service drift between systemd status and actual reachable runtime.
